title: MZ QTE's in battles to dodge, counter, perform attacks and strengthen these attacks?

posts.author: Viptor333
posts.body:
Hello dear RPG Maker Community,
I'm currently in the process of programming my first game in RPG Maker MZ. I would like to build my own combat system, but I don't know how or which plugins I need for it. I want to have a combat system similar to Mario and Luigi 1. So before you carry out an attack you have to press a certain key combination in order to complete a successful attack, and if this key sequence fails, the damage will either be very low or no damage will be caused. If you have enough experience with the attack (or have taken the skill in the skill tree), you can press an additional button to strengthen the attack. For example, if you have to press R, T, Z, M and C one after the other in 5 seconds, another key like G appears between the T and Z. If you press the key after T you strengthen your attack. Over time, the number of such "buff buttons" will increase.
If you dodge an opponent, I would also like to make use of this mechanic, but these "buff buttons" are intended to serve as a counterattack or at least to produce a strong damage reduction for powerful magical attacks.
It would help me a lot if you could give me plugins or tips so that I can program my game successfully.
I wish you a nice day and thank you for the answers in advance!
~Viptor

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
For MV there's SRD's timed attacks plugins. For MZ MauiGameStudio has a tutorial on how to do it with VisuStella (or scripts alone) and Synrec has some paid plugins.
